ABOUT_BODY: it pulls in your Steam & PSN games, your trophy count, your MyAnimeList, and your live Discord status, then makes it all look ✧expensive✧. no fiddly setup. just paste the link and flex.
ABOUT_CONTACT_B: Questions or ideas: {support}. Legal and copyright: {legal}. Answers to most things are in the {help} and the {faq}.
ABOUT_D1_B: Connect {list} and {last}. Most only need your public username, and everything stays in sync on its own.
ABOUT_D2_B: Your live Discord status and the game you're in, a live League of Legends match with the free desktop app, and the episode or chapter you're on with the browser extension.
ABOUT_D3_B: Layouts like Diary, Journal, Arcade and Locket, your colors and backgrounds, a GIF avatar and a little pixel pet.
ABOUT_D4_B: {explore} shows who plays the same games or watches the same anime, and Blend compares two pages with a match percentage.
ABOUT_D5_B: Every layout, link and connection is free. Glow+ ({monthly} a month or {yearly} a year) adds cosmetics like cursors, trails, background effects and premium domains.
ABOUT_INTRO: Glow (glow.moe) is a free link-in-bio page for gamers and anime fans. You get one page at glow.moe/yourname with your links plus the games you play, your trophies and achievements, your anime and manga lists, your favorite characters and what you're playing or watching right now, synced from the accounts you connect.
